abstract: Cleavage-stage mouse embryos aggregate and form chimaeric blastocysts with embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells. We used scanning and transmission electron microscopy to study cell relationships during aggregate formation between 8-cell-stage embryos and F9 EC cells. Relations between heterotypic cells were similarly studied in aggregation experiments with embryos and teratocarcinoma-derived visceral (PSA5-E) and parietal (PYS-2) endoderm cells and in experiments with EC cells and endoderm cells. The embryos and F9 cells always adhered to each other and rapidly formed compacted aggregates. Numerous microvilli and cell processes, originating from both embryo and EC cells, extended between the two cell types during adhesion and early phases of aggregation. The aggregation process involved spreading of the blastomeres on the EC cells. Frequent adherent junctions and close contacts, including possible focal gap or tight junctions were observed between the embryo and F9 cells after 3 h of culture. Apparent gap or tight junctions were infrequent during the early phases of aggregation but during further culture, extensive typical gap junctions were also seen between embryo and EC cells. The embryos adhered only irregularly and loosely to PSA5-E and PYS-2 cells; this interaction never led to aggregate formation comparable to that seen in the experiments with embryos and EC cells. Close contacts but no gap or tight junctions could be observed between the embryo and endoderm cells. On the other hand, both PSA5-E and PYS-2 cells readily adhered to and aggregated with EC cells. The present results suggest that microvilli and cell processes mediate membrane interactions during adhesion and early phases of aggregation between embryos and EC cells. During aggregation, blastomeres spread over the EC cells, and rapid formation of adherent junctions and close contacts, including possible focal gap or tight junctions is involved during the early phases of this process. After this initial phase, typical gap junctions are also seen between the embryo and EC cells. Interestingly, adhesive properties of embryo and EC cells differ: the former aggregate only with EC cells, whereas the latter do so also with teratocarcinoma-derived visceral and parietal endoderm cells. Mechanisms operating in the morphogenetic movement of cells in this experimental setup may be involved also in the development of the blastocyst in vivo.
abstract_ja: マウス卵割期胚は胎児性癌（EC）細胞と凝集し、キメラ胚盤胞を形成する。本研究では、走査型および透過型電子顕微鏡を用いて、8細胞期胚とF9 EC細胞の凝集中の細胞間関係を検討した。異種細胞間の関係も、胚と奇形癌由来の臓側内胚葉（PSA5-E）および壁側内胚葉（PYS-2）細胞、ならびにEC細胞と内胚葉細胞の実験で同様に検討した。胚とF9細胞は常に互いに接着し、速やかに緻密な凝集体を形成した。両細胞から伸びる多数の微絨毛と細胞突起が、接着および凝集の初期段階で両者の間に伸展した。凝集過程では、割球がEC細胞上に広がる現象が伴った。3時間培養後には、接着結合と密接な接触が頻繁に観察され、焦点性のギャップ結合またはタイト結合の可能性もみられた。接着初期には明らかなギャップ結合やタイト結合は稀であったが、さらに培養を続けると、胚とEC細胞の間に典型的なギャップ結合が広範に認められた。胚は臓側内胚葉（PSA5-E）および壁側内胚葉（PYS-2）細胞には不規則かつ緩くしか接着せず、胚とEC細胞の実験に匹敵する凝集体形成には至らなかった。胚と内胚葉細胞の間には密接な接触は見られたが、ギャップ結合やタイト結合は認められなかった。一方、PSA5-EおよびPYS-2細胞はEC細胞と容易に接着し、凝集した。本結果は、微絨毛と細胞突起が接着および凝集初期の膜相互作用を媒介することを示唆している。凝集中、割球はEC細胞上に広がり、初期段階では接着結合や、焦点性ギャップ結合またはタイト結合の可能性を含む密接な接触が速やかに形成される。初期段階の後には、胚とEC細胞の間に典型的なギャップ結合も認められた。興味深いことに、接着特性は両者で異なり、胚はEC細胞とのみ凝集するのに対し、EC細胞は奇形癌由来の内胚葉細胞とも凝集する。この実験系における細胞の形態形成運動の機序は、生体内での胚盤胞発生にも関与している可能性がある。
